paragraphs.text: The House of Ingkara is one of the five Houses in Estark , located in Kush , on Dominaria .

Ingkara's color is purple, and its fighters are generally associated with blue and red mana. Before the Time of Troubles , the building of Ingkara was a heavy, squat structure with massive pillars lining its front and a great arched entryway from which a purple banner hung. As of the 998th Festival in 4069 AR , the House hosted 89 fighters.
Jimak Ravelth (from before the Night of Fire until the Time of Troubles )
Balzark : he reported Garth 's victory over Naru to Jimak.
Gilganorin : a fighter who battled Garth in the Arena . He was killed by Kuthuman after his surrender.
Igun : he fought against Garth in a death match, and was eaten by a Craw Wurm
Jolina : a fighter paired against Azema of Kestha in a death match.
Mina : a legendary fighter whose feet were bitten off by gnomes, while he was unconscious.
Silmar : he wasn't a true Ingkara fighter, but a captain from Tantium planted there by Zarel Ewine , in the hope of killing Garth. He was killed by a Lord of the Pit .
Ulin : he was very fast at gathering mana. He was killed by Garth in a death match.
